segments.name: TriNet
segments.description: Provides HR and payroll services to small businesses.
segments.evidence: We operate in one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Small businesses pay fees for payroll and benefits administration.
revenueModel.evidence: Through our ASO services model, we provide cloud-based HCM services to SMBs that allows them to manage hiring, onboarding, employee information, payroll processing, payroll tax administration, health insurance, and other benefits, from a single cloud-based software platform.
